source_review.notes: Reviewed the Chalmers QuickCheck publication record, current QuickCheck API, Hypothesis strategies/stateful/flakiness documentation, Proptest introduction/state-machine documentation, ScalaCheck and jqwik guides, and the primary metamorphic-testing and delta-debugging papers. All eleven final destinations returned HTTP 200.

evidence: Checked domains, generator support/configuration, sampled run notation, model/implementation transitions, observations, conformance relation, shrink relation, and simplicity measure for consistent scopes.
Separated a finite sampled conjunction from universal quantification and separated command sequences from concurrent invocation/response histories.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The chapter never uses arbitrary or random as a synonym for uniform or exhaustive.

evidence: Replayed the seeded harness over exactly 200 traces and confirmed the minimized trace push(0), push(1), pop produces expected=1 and actual=0.
Checked every one-command deletion of the three-command trace: deletion either removes divergence or makes pop illegal, establishing the stated deletion-local result.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The finite seeded run is counterexample evidence for the intentional demonstration defect only.

evidence: Re-derived finite-trace conformance by initialization and induction over legal model/implementation transitions.
Re-derived shrink termination from strict descent in a well-founded lexicographic complexity measure.
Re-derived the independent-trial miss expression (1-p)^n by multiplication of per-trial miss probability, with its assumptions stated.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No confidence percentage is inferred when trigger probability or independence is unknown.

evidence: Reviewed empty/singleton, duplicate/all-equal, absent/present, threshold, skew/depth, collisions, mutable policies, invalid encodings, callback/allocation/I/O failure, aliases, and cleanup.
Reviewed discard exhaustion, invalid shrink candidates, changing failure identity, framework/generator version drift, global randomness, locale/architecture, timeouts, and flaky replay.
Reviewed concurrent histories, schedule bounds, races, hostile sizes, cyclic input, resource exhaustion, sensitive clinical data, and high-stakes human-review boundaries.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Generated destructive commands and uncontrolled external writes are explicitly excluded.

evidence: Generated and minimized cases remain in the stated property domain; illegal-operation testing uses a separately declared domain.
Each stateful command advances the model and subject once before comparing results and the conformance relation.
Replay evidence retains concrete cases and environment/tool/generator identity; semantic coverage reports observed categories rather than nominal type size.
invariant_checking.notes: Oracle independence is treated as an engineering obligation rather than assumed from a second code path.

evidence: Reviewed the state-machine implication against initialization, legal-command, transition, observation, and conformance assumptions.
Reviewed the shrink argument against strict decrease, validity preservation, failure preservation, and local-versus-global minimality.
Reviewed the probability expression and rejected its use as a correctness certificate without a known trigger probability, stationarity, and independence.
proof_review.notes: The proof structures concern finite harness traces and shrink termination, not arbitrary implementation correctness.

evidence: Finite induction and probability derivations name assumptions and explicitly limit their conclusions.
Concurrency and clinical examples state specialized verification and named human review needs without claiming those reviews occurred.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Passing generated tests are never described as proof, certification, or deployment authorization.

evidence: The standard-library Python snippet passed exact six-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status under the recorded toolchain.
It emits evidence=finite_seeded_model_search, and all eleven cited source destinations plus all local links were directly checked.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No third-party property framework, production data structure, concurrent scheduler, performance characteristic, security boundary, or clinical system was empirically evaluated.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed contract derivation; representation, algebraic, model, differential, metamorphic, and stateful properties; generator support/distribution; constructive generation/filtering; boundaries; shrinking/minimality; oracle independence; replay; semantic coverage; probability limits; fuzzing; concurrency; security; and high-stakes review boundaries.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed generator specifications, discard and coverage metrics, failure databases, regression promotion, tool/version pinning, debug versus public properties, failure injection, cleanup, flake handling, model dependency graphs, schedule/history capture, race-tool complementarity, and sandbox constraints.

pedagogical_review.notes: Builds directly on DSE-001 through DSE-008, moves from pure properties to stateful and concurrent limits, critically incorporates useful legacy generator/shrinking/model material, includes one inspectable counterexample search, counters fourteen misconceptions, and supplies ten examples plus five matched exercises and answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external property-testing maintainer, language/runtime, concurrency, security, reliability, data-governance, medical, clinical, safety, privacy, regulatory, quality, accessibility, human-factors, or independent review is claimed. The chapter and finite evidence prove neither generator completeness, oracle correctness, arbitrary data-structure correctness, race freedom, security, performance, clinical safety, certification, nor deployment fitness.
